She reveals how all pain has a purpose and that brokenness is actually a blessing. Many times throughout life, storms will rise and winds will blow and cause disastrous shipwreck to take place. Dr. Williams teaches you how to survive shipwreck and overcome life’s storms by inspiring you to swim your way out on broken pieces.
